findings.message: `Image.quantize(method=0, dither=0)` may fail on grayscale images or produce posterization on gradients. Use `colors=256` and remove `dither=0` to allow Floyd-Steinberg, or set `method=Image.Quantize.MEDIANCUT` explicitly.
`config._default_cfg_dict()` is private. Use `config.DEFAULT_CONFIG` or a public accessor.
`code_chunks_line` is defined but unused; either inline the regex or remove it.
Variable `row_h` is misleading — it holds the global max width, not row height. Rename to `max_row_w`.
Hardcoded 128 colors may lose detail. Increase to 256 or make configurable.
Statement ". never writes" contradicts Note that hash is stored. Clarify that only plaintext is excluded, not hash.
